sourceNotes.rawContent:
A minimalist rectangular bar pendant set with a rich amethyst-purple stone, finished with a smooth gold bezel. The horizontal bar design sits centered on a fine gold chain, adding a modern, understated pop of color to any look. Crafted in 18K gold-plated stainless steel, it's tarnish and water resistant, so it holds its shine through everyday wear.
Simple, elegant, and versatile, this necklace works beautifully as a birthstone piece for February or as an everyday accent for anyone drawn to purple hues.
Details:
- Material: 18K gold-plated stainless steel, tarnish and water resistant
- Stone: Amethyst-purple cubic zirconia, bar bezel setting
- Chain: Fine link chain, adjustable length
- Pendant size: Approx. 1.2cm x 0.6cm
